description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sandagiripura, Tissamaharamaya D/S Division, Hambantota District - Cad. Map No. 830076
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and title classifications. The content is focused on land property matters and falls squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
